answers.users: AI Assistants (Cursor/Claude), Human Developers, Bot Authors
answers.user_goals: Execute complex multi-step workflows without losing context; Run autonomous workflows with pause points; Define workflows with loops/branches easily
answers.primary_stakeholders: Human developers and AI assistants using StoryBot
answers.first_action: Run a TDD workflow with automatic test-code loops and human review checkpoints
answers.problems_to_eliminate: Rigid linear workflow; Workflow creation friction; Need foundation for future agentic capabilities. Core need: Make it really easy to create custom multi-step workflows with arbitrary flow patterns
answers.pain_points: Manual re-invocation when validation fails; Loss of context between behaviors; No pause/resume capability
answers.critical_blockers: Cannot express loop-until-pass patterns; Cannot mix autonomous and interactive modes; Cannot checkpoint and resume
answers.value_drivers: Reduced manual intervention; Reliable state via checkpointing; Declarative workflow definition
answers.outcomes: Zero breaking changes; LangGraph purely additive via --workflow flag; Single ActionNode class; Two execution modes
answers.user_journey: Invoke --workflow -> LangGraph executes nodes -> Checkpoints saved -> Pause at interactive points -> Resume with --continue -> Complete
answers.journey_stages: Invoke, Execute, Checkpoint, Pause, Resume, Complete
answers.frustration_points: Absence of this capability - must manually orchestrate complex workflows
answers.delight_moments: Autonomous TDD loops; Resume exactly where left off; Checkpoint history as audit trail
answers.integrations: LangGraph, SQLite checkpoints, Existing Actions, CLI flags
answers.integration_points: CLI detects --workflow routes to LangGraphRunner; ActionNode wraps action.execute; SqliteSaver persists state
answers.sub_domains: Graph Building, Node Execution, State Management, Mode Switching
answers.boundaries: Default workflow uses legacy files; LangGraph uses checkpoints.db - completely separate systems
answers.domain_events: WorkflowStarted, NodeExecuted, CheckpointSaved, WorkflowPaused, WorkflowResumed, WorkflowCompleted
answers.business_rules: LangGraph opt-in via --workflow; Default untouched; Two-pass pattern; Autonomous vs Interactive modes
answers.domain_language: Workflow, Graph, Node, Edge, Behavior, Action, Checkpoint, Resume, Autonomous, Interactive

answers.initiating_actions: User runs CLI with --botlangflow parameter, CLI detects parameter, Bot routes to BotLangFlowRunner, BotLangFlowRunner loads BotLangFlow Python file, Compiles graph, Executes nodes
answers.system_responses: Bot builds initial BotLangState, BotLangFlowRunner invokes compiled graph, BotLangActionNode wraps action.execute, Updates BotLangState, SqliteSaver checkpoints state, Returns results to CLI, Pauses at interactive nodes, Resumes with --continue flag
answers.preconditions: BotLangFlow Python file exists in orchestration/flows/ directory, Bot has behavior/action configuration, CLI context available, SqliteSaver database initialized
answers.success_criteria: BotLangFlow executes nodes in sequence, State persists via checkpoints, Autonomous mode runs without pausing, Interactive mode pauses for human input, Resume continues from exact checkpoint, All nodes complete successfully
answers.alternate_flows: BotLangFlow file not found, Invalid graph structure, Checkpoint load failure, Node execution error, Human cancels at interactive pause, Resume with invalid thread_id, State corruption, Conditional routing to different paths, Loop iterations
answers.sequencing_constraints: Foundation components first: BotLangActionNode, BotLangFlowRunner, BotLangFlow definitions, Checkpoint/Resume capability. CLI routing depends on BotLangFlowRunner. Execution depends on BotLangActionNode.
answers.domain_rules: BotMode determines execution behavior, BotLangActionNode enforces two-pass pattern, SqliteSaver ensures state persistence, thread_id uniquely identifies workflow instance, Checkpoints enable exact resume, BotLangState schema is flow-specific
answers.testability: Yes - Each story can be tested with: Mock BotLangFlow files, Test BotLangState instances, In-memory SqliteSaver, Stub actions, Isolated thread_ids
answers.external_systems: LangGraph framework, File system, SQLite database, Existing Action classes, CLI
answers.contracts: BotLangFlowRunner.load_flow returns BotLangFlow Python module, BotLangFlow.build returns StateGraph, StateGraph.compile returns CompiledGraph, BotLangActionNode.__call__ returns updated_state, SqliteSaver.save returns checkpoint_id
answers.integration_points: LangGraph StateGraph creation, SqliteSaver checkpoint persistence, BotLangFlow Python import, Action.execute invocation, CLI flag detection, State schema validation
answers.failure_handling: BotLangFlow file load error returns CLI error message, Node execution error preserves checkpoint and returns error, Checkpoint save failure fails workflow, Resume with bad thread_id returns error message, Invalid state schema returns validation error
answers.data_variations: Empty BotLangState, Full BotLangState with all fields, Single-node flow, Multi-node flow with branches, Loop flow, Interactive nodes, Autonomous nodes, Mixed mode flows, Multiple checkpoints, Resume from different checkpoints
answers.input_values: botlangflow_name, behavior, action, parameters, thread_id, checkpoint_id, mode, BotLangState, continue_flag
answers.output_values: Successful execution returns final BotLangState with results, Interactive pause returns prompt dict with needs_confirmation flag, Resume continues from checkpoint, Error returns error message with context, Checkpoint returns checkpoint_id, Complete returns workflow results
answers.formulas: No complex formulas - mainly state transitions and routing logic. Validation: State schema compliance, Checkpoint integrity, thread_id uniqueness, Node sequence correctness
answers.domain_entities: BotMode: autonomous/interactive, BotLangState fields, Node types: BotLangActionNode and Decision Node, Checkpoint metadata: thread_id, checkpoint_id, timestamp
answers.boundary_conditions: Empty flow, Single node, 100+ nodes, Empty BotLangState, Max BotLangState, thread_id collision, Invalid checkpoint_id, Resume after long delay, Concurrent executions, State size limits
